result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, with one clear content defect: the promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−100%', which is an implausible discount value. No other visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behaviour.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' restaurant card (pizza image) shows '−100%'. A 100% discount is implausible and is likely a wrong value or formatting/calculation error (e.g., meant −10% or −20%).
issues.suggestion: Check the promotion data source and badge formatting logic. Display the correct discount percentage, and add validation so out-of-range values (e.g., ≥100%) are not rendered.
